title: hive-pool open-generation: request body
description: Opens the next execution generation of an item under an admitted admission and the Imperative revision it is bound to, and moves a queued item to in-flight in the same transaction. Refused while another generation is open, while an active hold stands (held), or for a decision item. Nothing is launched: the caller, a later stage's dispatcher, launches after this returns.

admission_id.description: Must be in state admitted, for this item, and its last check must have read the item's current revision and the Imperative's current revision.

opened_by.description: The launch intent or request that opens the generation, where the caller has one.
